setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 loops 8 steps on the test device with Merge Shape set to Foundation. Pattern 1 (C, D, E, F, MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65, on steps 1 to 4) is the protected Anchor and pattern 2 (trigs on steps 5 and 7) offers additions; both are assigned. Add amount is 100 and Add accent 70, so all candidate additions are allowed and sound at 70 percent of their velocity. The Phrase settings are still at their defaults, the norns shows the Rhythm page and the grid lights steps 1 to 5 and 7.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Press E1 once to the Phrase screen, turn E2 to Phrase and press K3. A cycle is one pass of the eight-step loop. Turn E3 once to set Cycles to 2.
steps.title: Set Cycles to 2

steps.caption: Turn E2 to Shape and E3 once to choose BUILD, which reads Cycle 1 50 and Cycle 2 100.
steps.title: Choose the Build shape

steps.caption: Press K3. The footer reads APPLIED.
steps.title: Apply the phrase

steps.caption: Tap Play (1,8) and listen. The first loop plays steps 1 to 4 plus one addition (step 7), five notes in the strip below.
steps.title: Loop 1 adds one note

steps.caption: The second loop plays steps 1 to 4 plus both additions (steps 5 and 7), six notes. Keep listening to at least four loops, then tap Stop.
steps.title: Loop 2 adds both

steps.caption: The two loops keep alternating: the strip below shows the notes of each pass, loop 1 with step 7 added and loop 2 with steps 5 and 7 added, back to the first anchor at the end.
steps.title: Build over two channel loops
